channel.title: Eye To Ad Media — SEO, AI Search and Conversion
channel.description: Plain-English guides on getting found on Google, Google Maps and AI search, and turning it into calls. Written by Zach Wennstedt, founder of Eye To Ad Media, Denver.

item.title: Your Website's Job Description: 9 Jobs While You Sleep
item.description: The nine jobs a small-business website should do after hours: answer and book, reply to leads within a minute, text back missed calls, ask for reviews, keep the Google Business Profile fresh, be quotable by AI search, load fast on phones, route inquiries and send a morning report. What good looks like, a five-minute check for each, and a scorecard.

item.title: Google Automated Calls: The Business Profile Settings Guide
item.description: Google’s automated calls now book appointments and check prices on a customer’s behalf. What the three Business Profile toggles do, which to leave on, the excluded states, how to spot a fake call, and what to say when it rings.

item.title: Reserve with Google by Trade: Which Scheduler Fits (2026)

item.title: Publish Your Prices: Why "Call for a Quote" Loses AI Jobs
